column1: # Candidate pool for scripts/idiom_mining.py -- Romanian idioms, regionalisms
# and church-register vocabulary, each with a test sentence, mined to find the
# ones a model does NOT already know.
# The point is NOT to ship this file. It is a sieve: every entry here is run
# through the translator with an EMPTY glossary, and only the ones that come out
# WRONG have any claim on a glossary slot. An entry the model already knows is
# exactly the "fluff" a padded glossary is made of -- it costs prompt tokens,
# competes for attention with the rules that matter, and buys nothing.
#   1 expression      the Romanian, as it would be spoken
#   2 meaning         the gloss that would go in config/glossary.tsv
#   3 test sentence   plausible sermon/church speech containing it
#   4 must            |-separated regexes; ANY match = meaning came through
#                     (may be empty where there is no clean literal to catch)
# CAVEAT FOR REVIEW: these were written from model knowledge, not by a native
# speaker, and regional attributions especially are the kind of thing that is
# easy to get subtly wrong. Anything promoted out of here into glossary.tsv
# should be checked by someone who speaks the register.
